children: Q3 revenue rose 10.7% year over year to RMB2.4B, while operating loss widened to RMB51.1M from RMB25.6M. Net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders narrowed to RMB55.7M from RMB107.1M.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Revenue RMB2.4B, up 10.7% YoY
Growth accelerated across both business lines, but does not offset worsening operating performance.
Operating loss RMB51.1M vs RMB25.6M
GAAP operating loss nearly doubled year over year; operating margin fell to -2.1% from -1.2%.
Non-GAAP operating loss RMB40.7M vs RMB10.8M
Adjusted operating losses also widened substantially, indicating profitability remains under pressure.
Product sales RMB1.0B, up 28.6% YoY
Product sales drove growth, while services revenue was essentially flat year over year.
Net loss RMB55.7M vs RMB107.1M
The narrower net loss contrasts with weaker operating results; unrealized investment losses fell year over year.
Repurchased 0.3M ADSs for about $0.9M
Repurchases used about 9% of the $10M authorization; $9.1M remained as of Nov. 24, 2026.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a mixed quarterly update: revenue growth continued, while operating losses widened despite a narrower net loss. Further quarters of improving operating margins and progress toward the stated 2026 GAP breakeven target would be needed to establish a stronger profitability catalyst.
